data.rationale: The proposal has the right procedure (Find a Park by State → state → park/site → section link) and the right three parameters (state, park, section), but it treats choosing the park and opening the section as two separate clicks done in that order, while the recorded run clicked the 'National Heritage Area' category link before the park, and it doesn't say how to find the park in the list, so an automation would need some adjustment.
